items.title: Supreme x Elliott Smith Fall 2026 Collaboration Collection
items.summary: Supreme is honoring Elliott Smith with a new Supreme x Elliott Smith collection, created with the permission of the late singer-songwriter’s estate for Fall 2026. The capsule includes outerwear, fleece, layering pieces and accessories. Archival-feeling photography and album references link the clothing directly to Smith’s catalog.The lineup is short and focused, with seven pieces in total. At the top of the range are a Work Jacket and a Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt, followed by a Thermal, three T-shirts and a Beanie.
